A model in dMod2 is a chain of function objects, each returning output and derivatives:

| class | constructors | mapping |
|---|---|---|
| `parfn` | `P()`, `Pexpl()`, `Pimpl()` | outer to inner parameters, or to a steady state |
| `prdfn` | `Xs()`, `Xf()` | parameters to trajectories, with (`Xs()`) or without sensitivities |
| `obsfn` | `Y()` | states to observables, observables to standard deviations |
| `objfn` | `normL2()`, `constraintL2()`, `datapointL2()`, `constraintStability()` | $-2 \log L$ |

`*` concatenates by the chain rule,

$$\frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} = \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}\,\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}\,
\frac{\partial p}{\partial \theta},$$

each factor exact, the middle one from the sensitivity equations; `+` adds objectives.
`normL2(data, g*x*pSS*p, e)` is the objective. Inner parameters are the symbols of the equations,
per condition; outer parameters are those of the fit.

The guide uses the model of Oppelt et al. [@oppelt2018model], NFκB signaling in HepG2 cells after
TNFα, from the project
[`examples/oppeltNPJSystBiolAppl2018`](https://github.com/dModverse/dMod2/tree/master/examples/oppeltNPJSystBiolAppl2018).
This chapter follows `model.R`. Multistarts, profiles and other expensive results were computed
once by the scripts of the project and are stored in `results/*.rds`; the chapters load them with
`stored()`, which warns if a source script changed since.

```{r setup}
```

## Reaction network

TNFα activates the receptor, the receptor IKK, and IKK phosphorylates IκBα and NFκB in their
complex. Free NFκB enters the nucleus and induces IκBα and A20, the two negative feedbacks.

`addReaction()` adds a reaction to an `eqnlist`; `assignCompartment()` places the nuclear species
in the nucleus of relative volume `Vnuc`. Rates are concentration rates in the compartment of the
educts (of the products without net educts):

$$\dot x_i = \frac{1}{V_i} \sum_r S_{ri}\, V_{c(r)}\, v_r(x, p),$$

with $S_{ri}$ the stoichiometry and $V_{c(r)}$ the volume of the compartment of reaction $r$.

```{r reactions, echo = FALSE}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# one row per reaction, both sides as written in addReaction(), so that a catalyst appears on
# both sides; the chunk runs again with an addReaction() that records the arguments
written <- list()
record <- new.env()
record$addReaction <- function(eqnlist, from, to, rate, description = names(rate), ...) {
  force(eqnlist)
  written[[length(written) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(from = from, to = to, rate = unname(rate),
                                                 description = description)
  dMod2::addReaction(eqnlist, from, to, rate, description, ...)
}
eval(parse(text = knitr::knit_code$get("reactions")), record)
written <- do.call(rbind, written)
stopifnot(identical(written$rate, unname(as.character(reactions$rates))))
side <- function(v) ifelse(v == "", "∅", sprintf("`%s`", v))
knitr::kable(data.frame(reaction = paste(side(written$from), "→", side(written$to)),
                        rate = sprintf("`%s`", written$rate), description = written$description),
             row.names = FALSE)
```

<details><summary>Code</summary>

```{r, ref.label = "reactions", eval = FALSE}
```

Expressions follow the
[expression language of cppDE](https://dmodverse.github.io/cppDE/reference/expressions.html);
factors `eta_` relate two rates.

```{r}
length(reactions$states)
as.eqnvec(reactions)[c("NfkIkb", "nNfk", "TNF", "TNFR")]
```

## Observation functions

Readouts (live-cell imaging, immunoblots) are sums of species with scale `s_`, offset `off_` and,
for imaging, bleaching rate `tau_`, on the natural log scale:

$$y = \log(s\, x + o) - \tau t .$$

```{r observables}
```

## Error model

Blots have a standard deviation per point in the column `sigma`; imaging readouts get an
estimated one. Rows with a value in `sigma` ignore the error model.

```{r errors}
```

## Steady-state constraints

NFκB and IKK are conserved, so $f(x, p) = 0$ determines the resting state only with the totals:

```{r}
conservedQuantities(reactions)
```

`Pimpl()` solves the steady state numerically, with the totals `totalNfk` and `totalIkk` as
parameters, `TNF` at 0, and exact derivatives of the root
([Methods > Steady states](methods-steady-states.html)). `steadyStates()` is the analytic
alternative.

```{r steadystate}
```

## Events and switches

An event at time 0 sets `TNF` to `dose_TNF`, 1 under stimulation, 0 in the control. Event times
and values may be parameters. `"piecewise(kon, A > A0, koff)"` switches a rate on a state, with
exact sensitivities
([cppDE > Events](https://dmodverse.github.io/cppDE/articles/methods-events.html)).

## Prediction functions

`odemodel()` generates C++ code for the ODE and the sensitivity equations, `Xs()` the `prdfn` `x`,
`Y()` the observables `g` and the error model `e`; `compile = FALSE` defers to one `compile()`.

```{r odemodel}
```

The backend `"cppDE"` (default) integrates by BDF, `"Sundials"` uses CVODES, `"deSolve"` deSolve.
A step is accepted if
$\bigl(\tfrac1n \sum_i \varepsilon_i^2 / (\mathrm{atol} + \mathrm{rtol}\,|x_i|)^2\bigr)^{1/2} \le 1$:

| option | default | controls |
|---|---|---|
| `atol`, `rtol` | `1e-6`, `1e-6` | absolute and relative error per step |
| `maxsteps` | `1e6` | steps per solve |
| `maxattempts` | `50` | rejected steps in a row |
| `hini` | `0` | first step, 0 estimates it |
| `sensErrCon` | `TRUE` | (`optionsSens` only) sensitivities in the error test |

`model.R` sets `rtol = 1e-8`, `atol = 1e-10`, since log observables magnify errors of small states.

## Parameter transformation

`define()` and `insert()` build the assignments of the `parfn` `p`:

- `define("x <- x", x = ...)` takes every parameter of `pSS`, `x`, `g` and `e` except the states,
  whose values come from the steady state;
- `insert("x <- exp(x)", x = ...)` puts every symbol on the log scale;
- `define("TNF <- 0")` sets TNFα to 0 for the steady state;
- `branch(covariates(data))` copies the assignments per condition, `define(..., conditionMatch =)`
  sets the dose.

```{r transformation}
```

```{r}
getEquations(p, conditions = "TNF")[c("dose_TNF", "TNF", "totalNfk", "Vnuc")]
getEquations(p, conditions = "control")[c("dose_TNF", "TNF")]
```

`compile()` builds one shared object in `getOption("dMod2.outdir")`, reusing unchanged objects.

```{r compile}
```

```{r}
length(getParameters(prd))
```

## Likelihood and prior

`normL2(data, prd, e)` returns $-2 \log L$ with gradient and Gauss-Newton Hessian
([Methods > Likelihood and prior](methods-objective.html)). `constraintL2()` adds a Gaussian prior
on the log scale, also the start distribution of [Optimization](guide-optimization.html): mean 0
and standard deviation 4 by default, narrower where the magnitude is known:

| parameters | mean | sd | reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| bleaching rates `tau_*` | $\log(0.1/360)$ | 2 | about 10 % of signal lost over six hours |
| imaging noise `sigma_*` | $\log 0.05$ | 1 | replicates scatter by about 5 % |
| basal rates `*_Base` | $-8$ | 2 | activation without TNFα far slower than with it |
| `shuttle_RnaA20`, `degrad_RnaA20`, `build_A20`, `degrad_A20`, `degrad_mIkb` | $\log(1/60)$ | 2 | transcripts and A20 turn over within about an hour |
| `trigger_iIkk` | $\log(1/240)$ | 2 | IKK recovers over hours |

`pSS` also returns unstable roots (`controlsPTC = list(stability = FALSE)`);
`constraintStability()` is zero on a stable resting state and reaches 100 per eigenvalue at the
stability boundary, and needs `Pimpl(derivMode = "forward-forward")`
([Methods > Steady states](methods-steady-states.html#stability)).

```{r objective}
```

```{r tolerances}
```

## Model evaluation

```{r, echo = FALSE}
invisible(stored("results/fits.rds", "fit.R"))
```

The best fit of [Optimization](guide-optimization.html), with the gauge of
[Symmetries](guide-symmetries.html):

```{r gauge, echo = FALSE}
```

```{r}
best <- as.parvec(readRDS("results/fits.rds"))
value <- obj(best, fixed = gauge)
c(value = value$value, data = attr(value, "data"), prior = attr(value, "prior"))
max(abs(value$gradient))
```

Prediction and data, with one standard deviation of the error model as a band:

```{r, fig.height = 7}
times <- seq(0, 360, length.out = 361)
last <- pmax(with(lbind(data), tapply(time, name, max)), 30)
plotCombined(prd(times, c(best, gauge), deriv = FALSE), data, time <= last[as.character(name)],
             errfn = e) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "time [min]", y = "log signal [a.u.]")
```
